title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 25
intro: Round 25 (2026-11-08). Your four versions are in as you sent them: the reminder in the first five minutes, the anchor line and your don'ts for the person helping, your (Re)defining "Bad Trip", and your Give the Session. Your (Re)defining reads Human by itself, every window, three of them Medium ([its check](https://www.pangram.com/history/c192b361-98f5-4c64-bdc4-6df38dd0b62f)); the other three you checked yourself.

Why Bad Trips Tend to Happen is under your (Re)defining now, said once: its picture, the causes your paragraph doesn't name (drug interactions, sleep, cannabis, hunger, fasting, breathwork, retreat pressure and the rest) and the CBT thinking traps moved there, and its "That frame can be useful" line and the causes you already give went. The guide also no longer assumes a drug where it speaks generally: 16 lines ([the list](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h32-20261108/DRUG-READ.md)). Two were in your new versions, so each went in only after its check read Human: "or how hard you pushed a practice" ([Human](https://www.pangram.com/history/f99fb1f0-34d7-4013-a3bb-95dc4b86645c)), and "think through beforehand" for "before you take anything" (your whole section, [Human, High](https://www.pangram.com/history/14a16456-64d6-4f7e-b4b6-0e6686fa3d9e)). A third, "once your head is clear" for "sober" in No Rash Actions' bold line, sits in a stretch that read Mixed before, so it gets its check with that stretch.
One card is left from the merge, because it would drop a warning the fidelity check holds.

edits.before: Every hard experience can feel like a profound lesson. But sometimes the lesson is just to lower the dose or stop the practice, get some sleep and something to eat, pick safer people, and admit that the room is bad.
